statements.statement: A protected member can be accessed by a subclass that extends the class.
statements.explanation: Protected members are accessible inside the class and any class that extends it, which is the main purpose of the protected modifier.

statements.statement: A protected member can be accessed directly on an instance from outside the class.
statements.explanation: Protected members are not accessible from outside code. Only code inside the class or a subclass can use them.

statements.statement: Protected is more restrictive than private.
statements.explanation: Private is more restrictive than protected. Private members are only accessible inside the class itself, while protected members are also accessible in subclasses.
